perfil_profesional: Dean of the Faculty of International, Political and Urban Studies (2018-2025) . Colombian diplomat and Doctor Honoris Causa in Law and Jurisprudence from the Nueva Granada Military University in Bogotá - Colombia. He belonged to the Colombian Army between 1954 and 1981. He served as Ambassador of Colombia to Cuba (1998-2010), Ambassador of Colombia to the OAS (1990-1994), Minister of Foreign Affairs (1986-1990), Ambassador of Colombia to the Panama (1983-1986) and Ambassador of Colombia to the United Nations (1994-1998).Areas of interest:Negotiation of conflicts, international relations, geography and history, law of the sea, borders and limits of Colombia
formacion_academica: 1990, Doctor Honoris Causa en Derecho y Jurisprudencia, Universidad Militar Nueva Granada
